title: 開設状態の折畳み式マーケット屋台
description: 広場の市やイベント物販に使う2 m級の仮設屋台。四脚の伸縮支柱、交差支え、4面の布屋根と垂れ、独立したカウンターと棚をひとつの静止セットにまとめました。商品、看板、地面、実際の開閉・耐風性能は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.052 × 2.798 × 2.052 m、8,888三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A roughly two-metre temporary market stall for plazas and event sales, with four telescopic legs, scissor braces, four fabric roof panels and valances, plus an independent counter and shelf in one static assembly. No goods, signs, ground, folding behavior or wind-resistance performance is supplied. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.052 × 2.798 × 2.052 m; 8,888 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
